about: Founded by senior software engineers Karabo Khunou, Nqobile Buthelezi, and Tebogo Mkhize, KNT delivers uncompromising technical excellence. From domain-driven enterprise Spring Boot architectures to cloud infrastructure, reactive Angular frontends, 3D WebGL computing, and native iOS banking platforms, we build systems that endure real-world load and scale.

services.title: Enterprise Backend & Distributed Architecture
services.description: High-throughput APIs, microservice ecosystems, and robust domain modeling built with modern Java and Spring Boot. We deliver secure, fault-tolerant transactional backends designed for enterprise volume.
deliverables: Domain-driven design & logical relational data modeling
Spring Security filter chains & token authentication

services.title: Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps & Reliability
services.description: Resilient cloud environments, zero-downtime containerized architectures, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines engineered to ensure 99.99% operational continuity.
deliverables: Automated CI/CD build & test delivery pipelines

services.title: Modern Web Platforms & Design Systems
services.description: Enterprise-grade single-page applications engineered with Angular standalone architecture, TypeScript, and modern CSS. Fast, accessible, and resilient frontends that streamline complex client workflows.
deliverables: Fine-grained reactive state management with signals
Responsive, high-contrast design systems & UI/UX tokens
SEO, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals optimization

services.title: Interactive 3D WebGL & Spatial Computing
services.description: Browser-based 3D graphics, simulation environments, and audio-synchronized interactive experiences powered by Three.js and React Three Fiber without bulky external plugins.
deliverables: Custom shaders, camera controllers & lighting scenes

services.title: Native iOS & Digital Banking Engineering
services.description: Institutional-grade native mobile applications crafted in Swift with strict adherence to Apple Human Interface Guidelines, financial data protection, and offline reliability.
deliverables: Auto Layout & multi-device adaptive view hierarchies
Offline caching, security controls & biometric authentication

services.title: Architecture Audits & Technical Advisory
services.description: Comprehensive engineering assessments for CTOs, product leaders, and investors. We identify bottlenecks, resolve tech-debt vulnerabilities, and establish sustainable architectural roadmaps.
